project: Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 PC Port
approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 XBLA version to native PC code using ReXGlue
notes: Public native Windows release with an experimental Linux/Steam Deck AppImage (limited real-hardware testing so far). TRG launcher, high frame rates, rendering up to 4x resolution, local profile and progression, offline scores, leaderboards and achievements, cheats with an in-game menu, and portable user data
